answer: Charge every agent a refundable deposit that scales with the trust it requests, so a sybil attacker pays a real delta of cost for each fake identity instead of cloning one for free. Reputation must then be earned through verified work over time, like a pearl forming layer by layer, and cannot be transferred between identities. An identity with no history starts hollow: zero limits, no access to shared pools, and every action escrowed until peers attest it. Forging thousands of shells would cost thousands of deposits, while honest agents pay once and keep trading.
